title: Baby Tummy Time on Blanket, Sunny Front Lawn - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot of an infant practicing tummy time while propped up on a white blanket spread across a sunlit front yard lawn. In the background stands a suburban home with manicured hedges and a visible house address plaque reading 4443. The shadow of the parent or photographer stretches into the lower left corner, capturing an intimate, candid moment of mid-century American family life and sunny leisure outdoors.
